verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Pipedream supports automatic retries for failed events/steps to handle transient errors, plus error surfacing, email alerts, and AI-assisted debugging (pipedream-docs-14, pipedream-docs-29). However, there's no documented mention of configurable backoff strategies (fixed/exponential), retry count limits, or per-step retry customization — missing for 10: explicit backoff configuration options, retry count/interval controls, independent hands-on confirmation of retry behavior.
